q1_issues.issue: The quantifier "few" is mis-slotted as a property symbol in ConditionalProperty's property slot, where the instruction set instead maps "few" to strength 0.1 plus a QuantifierPhrase companion; the atom as written asserts at strength 0.9 that career possibilities have the property `few`, which the seeded cond_prop rule would then hand to each individual possibility.
The exceptive "Aside from being a professor" is dropped entirely — no atom mentions professor, so the parse states the "few" claim without the excluded case the sentence carves out.

q2_gaps: bare-existential quantity claim "there are few N": it has no subject-predicate pair for the Quantity-to-strength dial to sit on, and bare "few" (unlike "a few / several / a handful / dozens") is not in the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity lexicon, so no licensed carrier exists for it

exceptive "aside from X" scoping over a quantified domain — the instruction set lists "aside from" only as a defeasible-exception cue introducing a SUB-KIND that lacks or reverses a generic property, not as an exclusion from an existential/quantified claim
speaker-oriented evaluative sentence adverb ("unfortunately") — Manner covers only event-manner adverbs; there is no licensed encoding for an evaluative comment adverb
notes: The ConditionalProperty shape itself is licensed for the locative restriction "at the university" (the "berths are scarce at the marina" pattern), and the career_possibility compound genus with the noun modifier left unexposed follows the compound-kind rule correctly.
